title: CPF Module Schema: Service Bus Namespace module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-servicebusnamespace'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

authorization_rules.type: map(object({ listen = optional(bool) send = optional(bool) manage = optional(bool) }))
authorization_rules.description: (Optional) A map of servicebus_namespace_authorization_rule object as defined below. This creates a `azurerm_servicebus_namespace_authorization_rule` for each item in the map: Key = "(Required) Specifies the name of the Service Bus Namespace Authorization Rule. Should be unique for each namespace." Value = object({ listen = "(Optional) Grants listen access to this this Authorization Rule. Defaults to `false`." send = "(Optional) Grants send access to this this Authorization Rule. Defaults to `false`." manage = "(Optional) Grants manage access to this this Authorization Rule. When this property is `true` - both `listen` and `send` must be too. Defaults to `false`." })

capacity.description: (Optional) Specifies the capacity. When sku is `Premium`, capacity can be `1`, `2`, `4`, `8` or `16`.

cmk_key_name.description: (optional) Key name to be used (max 127 chars)

cmk_rotation_policy.type: object({ notify_before_expiry = string time_before_expiry = string time_after_creation = optional(string, null) expire_after = string })
cmk_rotation_policy.description: (Optional) A rotation policy block as defined below object({ notify_before_expiry = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." time_before_expiry = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." time_after_creation = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." expire_after = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." })

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

create_role_assignment.description: Whether to create the Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User role assignment. Set to false if the role assignment already exists.

customer_managed_key.type: object({ key_vault_id = string infrastructure_encryption_enabled = optional(bool, null) expiration_date = string identity_id = string identity_principal_id = string })
customer_managed_key.description: (Required) An customer_managed_key block as defined below object({ key_vault_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the Key Vault where the Key Vault Key resides." infrastructure_encryption_enabled = "(Optional) Used to specify whether enable Infrastructure Encryption (Double Encryption). Changing this forces a new resource to be created." expiration_date = "(Required) Expiration UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z')." identity_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key." identity_principal_id = "(Required) The principal ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key." })

disaster_recovery_config.type: object({ secondary_region = string secondary_resource_group_name = string identity = object({ type = optional(string, "SystemAssigned") identity_ids = optional(list(string), null) }) customer_managed_key = object({ infrastructure_encryption_enabled = optional(bool, null) identity_id = string identity_principal_id = string }) })
disaster_recovery_config.description: (Optional) A disaster recovery configuration block as defined below. These value are required only when you need to create a secondary Service Bus Namespace for the Disaster Recovery. object({ secondary_region = "(Required) The name of the Azure region where the secondary service bus namespace will be created. Please choose among the regional pairs only. identity = object({ type = "(Optional) Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this Service Bus Namespace. Possible values are `SystemAssigned` or `UserAssigned`. Defaults to `SystemAssigned`." identity_ids = "(Optional) Specifies a list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this Service Bus Namespace." }) customer_managed_key = object({ infrastructure_encryption_enabled = "(Optional) Used to specify whether enable Infrastructure Encryption (Double Encryption). Changing this forces a new resource to be created." identity_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key." identity_principal_id = "(Required) The principal ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key." }) })

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

identity.description: (Optional) An identity block as defined below object({ type = "(Required) Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this Linux Virtual Machine. Possible values are `SystemAssigned`, `UserAssigned`, `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned` (to enable both)." identity_ids = "(Optional) Specifies a list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this Linux Virtual Machine. This is required when `type` is set to `UserAssigned` or `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned`." })

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

key_vault_tags.description: (Optional) Key Vault related tags to be set on key vault child resources.

minimum_tls_version.description: (Optional) The minimum supported TLS version for this Service Bus Namespace. Valid values are: 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2. Defaults to 1.2.

network_rule_set.type: object({ default_action = optional(string, "Deny") trusted_services_allowed = optional(bool) ip_rules = optional(set(string)) network_rules = optional(list(object({ subnet_id = string ignore_missing_vnet_service_endpoint = optional(bool, false) })), null) })
network_rule_set.description: (Optional) This creates a `azurerm_servicebus_namespace_network_rule_set`: object({ default_action = "(Optional) Specifies the default action for the Network Rule Set. Possible values are `Allow` and `Deny`. Defaults to `Deny`." trusted_services_allowed = "(Optional) Are Azure Services that are known and trusted for this resource type are allowed to bypass firewall configuration?" ip_rules = "(Optional) Set of one or more IP Addresses, or CIDR Blocks which should be able to access the ServiceBus Namespace." network_rules = list(object({ subnet_id = "(Required) The Subnet ID which should be able to access this ServiceBus Namespace." ignore_missing_vnet_service_endpoint = "(Optional) Should the ServiceBus Namespace Network Rule Set ignore missing Virtual Network Service Endpoint option in the Subnet? Defaults to `false`." })) })

premium_messaging_partitions.description: (Optional) Specifies the number messaging partitions. Default value is 1. Possible values include 1, 2, and 4.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

drid.description: The ID of the Secondary Service Bus Namespace created.

drname.description: The Name of the Secondary Service Bus Namespace created.

drresource.description: The Secondary Service Bus Namespace resource created.

id.description: The ID of the Service Bus Namespace created.

name.description: The Name of the Service Bus Namespace created.

resource.description: The Service Bus Namespace resource created.

service_bus_auth_rule.description: The Service Bus Namespace authorization rule created.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Servicebusnamespace' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
